rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She says this as her hand gently rests on the hilt of the sword.
To all guests: The IPC will be conducting special operations within the hotel. Please follow the staff in charge of evacuation to the designated safe zones, or compulsory measures will be enforced!
rows.speaker: Team Leader

rows.text: I'll request a beating for you lot! You've been told not to drink during work hours!
Take him back to the hotel room!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...I'll organize a meeting later to properly go over how this incident report should be written!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...Miss Topaz! I never thought I'd run into you on Penacony.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Long time no see, Astral Express crew. Aventurine has told me a lot about your happenings... Hmm?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: There was a man from my homeland who, at a time when the world was grappling with deep, unhealable pain, made a choice.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: He wove together the dreams of everyone in the world, linking people's dreamscapes, and shouldered this burden himself. From this, he created a giant, a "Spiritual Adam."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...It's fine. Do as they ask, and try to avoid any conflicts with The Family... Report to me before taking any action. Mhm. Yes, alright.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...As you see — the IPC isn't very popular here on Penacony. Cordiality from The Family is a mere facade. The former frontier prison has turned around and cuffed its shackles on the IPC staff now.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Only Aventurine, who carries an invitation is allowed to attend the banquet. An entourage like us... We can only sit around in the reality Hotel, unauthorized to even enter dreams.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: No wonder Aventurine's scrambling to partner up with someone — the IPC can't back him up in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: His situation isn't optimistic, I hear. You're all helping to investigate some... dirt on The Family, are you not? Let me know if you need anything outside the Dreamscape. The IPC always treats its partners well.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Thank you, Miss Topaz. We're on our way to the Hounds to verify some intel. Perhaps you've had dealings with them?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yep, they're tailing us right now. Why not go and talk to them... it'll take the spotlight off me, being constantly stared at is really uncomfortable.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...countless others would surpass him, soaring to even greater heights.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: How does it feel to be in business with Aventurine? I bet you're not used to it.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: That's just his style. "All or nothing" is his mantra. He's always cozying up to his clients while egging them on to undertake some dangerous assignment with him... But everyone has their merits, so I won't comment further.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: But Aventurine's luck has always been good. He's always closed all his cases without a hitch, and basically never lost a gamble. Which is why on the issue of retaking Penacony I'm watching with keen interest.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: He's that good huh...
...I ended that man's life, alone.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It works only when all parties' interests are aligned.
Of course. It's business, after all. What's important is where you're seated at the table.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: As for the two cases... Apologies, but I don't have much info on them either. All I can do is ask you to keep digging for more details.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: We're carrying out our Captain's orders! Wh—What do you want!
rows.speaker: Careless Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: We made a mistake last time, and we're working hard to rectify it now. We don't have time for anything else! Surveilling the IPC Executive Topaz, ensuring that she stays put at The Reverie hotel during her time on Penacony... We've got the right one this time!
rows.speaker: Composed Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: (...So that's it, they were the pair who were after Firefly at the time.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That's right. We're investigating a murder for The Family. Can we speak to your Captain about the case?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right. We're investigating a murder for The Family. May we access the hotel's Dreampool entry records?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sheesh, why do you keep asking me that? We're in the middle of investigating a murder case for The Family. May we speak to your Captain about it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well...
rows.speaker: Careless Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Apologies. The Bloodhound Family is running an investigation up ahead. No unauthorized personnel allowed.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: ...Hold on a minute. I think I've seen you before, the gray-haired one.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: ...How much trouble have you stirred up exactly on Penacony?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...You think you look alike?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Wait, are you for real?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We're really sorry for troubling you. [Trailblazer], March, let's think of another way.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Another way... That's it! Didn't [Trailblazer] say something about that... What was it... clockwork? That got this guy to change his mind.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Can you perform it again, [Trailblazer]? That... Clockie magic!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's not bad if we're resolving a misunderstanding!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Please, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I was wondering what all the commotion was... Oh, it's you guys. Welcome. Since you made it here, what can I do for you?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Hello, Mr. Gallagher, sir. Judging from your tone, it sounds like you were expecting us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hahaha... Miss Himeko, you're too polite. There's no need to call me "Sir."
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Mr. Gallagher, you even know my name?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Of course I do! You folks are from the legendary Astral Express, and honorable guests of the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...I'm sorry for what happened to that kid.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You really didn't see anything? Think harder.
I... I've been slacking off at work these few days...
Why is it so big?
Could the stowaway incident be real...
It's detective work. Please understand.

This is also the reason why we've come to visit you, Mr. Gallagher. The Express can't just overlook the death of that child, so we've decided to help The Family get to the bottom of it, in the hopes of getting justice for her.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Nameless involved with The Family... What an unpredictable twist of fate.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Why...? What's wrong with The Family?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's nothing. On Penacony, everyone loves The Family.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: No matter how much one resists the "beautiful dream," when the time comes, they too will find it hard to let go... Who wants to leave a warm nest? Just idiots, little kids... and inebriated fools.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Mr. Gallagher seems to be getting at something.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You got it wrong, I'm not.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You want to discuss the case? Sure, come with me. This is not a good place to talk. Let's go elsewhere.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Even after that chilling tragedy, this dream is still running effortlessly.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Not possible! It was you the last time, yelling about some clockwork friendship while beating me up with that silver-haired girl!
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Other than The Family of the Harmony, it's hard to imagine any other power in the universe that could sustain a building of such magnitude.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Family itself is a huge, perfect building. Like... A living idol.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Each member of The Family sees themselves as a piece of the divine puzzle, revolving around a singular {RUBY_B#Aeon}core{RUBY_E#} and {RUBY_B#Harmony}a shared ideal{RUBY_E#}. Under THEIR command, they loyally fulfill their roles, offering themselves while also receiving sustenance in return.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Interesting analogy. Perhaps that's why Penacony's "beautiful dream" has persisted for so long.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thank you for cooperating with The Family's efforts... and also thank you for not making me actually get down on my knees and grovel.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: I didn't think you were the type who would kick someone when they were down.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: I... know you don't really mean that.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: That's just a metaphor. A metaphor! Don't you get it!?
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Did you not hear me? Even if the Dreammaster was here...
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: I'm warning you, if you keep insisting, I'm gonna have to show you my true power!
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Humans never learn...
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Humans will never understand one another...
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: ...Great, even if Qlipoth were here, THEY wouldn't be able to protect him.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But the human body has its limits, and so does the divine's.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That doesn't sound like the kind of comment a Galaxy Ranger would make.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Just pointing out the facts. Mr. Yang will definitely have a better sense of what's going on than I do.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Why do you say that, Miss Acheron?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The beautiful dream is crumbling, but not because of a particular Aeon, a particular faction, or a particular visitor. Its collapse stems from a certain inevitability of human nature. The Family refuses to acknowledge this, and it has ultimately backfired and become a catalyst...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: As people immerse their souls in the Dreamscape, where consequences and pain cease to exist, and only ease and pleasure prevail, they draw closer and closer to necrosis. Regardless of the perceived bliss, death looms as the inevitable conclusion.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Also, this necrosis will diffuse and spread. One piece of the puzzle's mutation will eventually cause the entire building to shake, break... and crumble.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...In the end, the dreams that people built in the name of freedom became the cage that imprisoned them.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I'm sure you've gained a lot from this trip, Miss Acheron. Are you willing to share your findings with me?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Of course... That's if I remember.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Don't mind me. It's just a habit. Owing to events in the past, I've become easily... forgetful. It's only when this sword is unsheathed that those hazy memories start to become clearer.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Take your time.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That should do it. I vividly remember everything that occurred on Penacony. Ask away.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The Moment of Daybreak — I've heard that's where the "Dawn Factory," which processes the foundation of the Dreamscape, is located.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Behind the Dreamscape's song and dance, stand many "imagination" factories. Workers create all kinds of whimsical works day in and day out in their dreams, then they return to reality and sleep on a narrow bed in a room — a far cry from luxury.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They say it will suffice. Experiencing the bizarre and motley Dreamscape is the best reward.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: There, I encountered a young woman who had just come of age, the perfect time to indulge in beautiful dreams. Her greatest wish was to one day move to the Golden Hour and see the magnificent garments that she had woven with her own hands.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: For certain reasons, her wish was difficult to fulfill. But I managed to bring her a garment.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Gilded Hour... It's said to be Penacony's Currency Center.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes... It is a fortress-like financial city, the economic heart of the Dreamscape. The Pepeshi people of the Alfalfa Family are there to keep it running, sending blood that is made from money everywhere on Penacony.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Everyone there is exquisitely dressed and always in a hurry. The greatest wish of the local Pepeshi people is for their future generations to work in the Gilded Hour.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I've never met anyone who was willing to talk. I could only stand at the crossroads, watching crowds of people hurrying like the wind through the jungle of steel, only to deposit the Alfalfa credits that they'd earned into the bank's vault.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I don't know if they would open the vault door, but before I left, I witnessed a well-dressed Pepeshi person plummet from the sky while those around him continued on their way, unfazed.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I hear the Blue Hour is very romantic. Do you have any tales to share?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Perhaps Mr. Yang has heard — there is a large boat called the "Eventide" anchored along the Sea of Dreams, where soft music and dancing persist endlessly every night.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I ran into a wizened lady there. She was at the dock waiting for her long-departed lover to return, waiting for countless hours within time that stood still.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: In the humid sea breeze, she spoke of her own youth — like many who desired wealth and love, they came to Penacony to pursue their dreams. Alas, her lover's consciousness was lost in the dark depths of the Sea of Dreams.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Finally, she suggested we continue our conversation on a boat in the shallows. I agreed, and boarded the boat with her, but she never said anything, her eyes absent-mindedly gazing at the horizon for what seemed like forever.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Finally, we retreated to the beach.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The Dreamscape of chic, luxury and consumerism — the Moment of Dusk — my companions have been there too.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Then you all must have seen those who are attempting to realize their dreams, or have realized them, scattering money as if it were dust, and betting it on all or nothing. Everything has a price, and everything can be bought or sold — even dreams themselves.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I saw an Intellitron there who was preparing to auction himself. When someone wins a bid, under stipulated periods and rules, he would do the buyer's every bidding, becoming that person's very possession.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That Intellitron had been auctioned off a dozen times, and I participated in his thirteenth. That was the grandest banquet I had ever attended, but never again did anyone cast another glance at him.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This time around, there were no successful bids for him.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This is what I've seen and heard along the way...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Someone once said to me: Penacony wasn't like this a long time ago, nor should it be.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I've traveled through the reality and Dreamscape of the Planet of Festivities, watched the tides of night rise and fall, when time stopped for people. Where the spirits of the rich and impoverished... remain forever fixed on their own scales.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This is why I think the collapse of the beautiful dream is inevitable.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: There might be a way to change everything.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Perhaps. But if this is indeed the world that people desire — if this is precisely why life chooses to slumber — should we still seek to change it?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Miss Acheron, now it's my turn to share a story with you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Since that moment, the giant stood between heaven and earth, becoming the pillar of the world's existence. As a price, those who found it hard to move forward, who could not advance... forever lost their "future."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: They slumbered in a dream devoid of disaster and pain, living out their days peacefully in the man's created utopia. And it is because of the wishes of those people, who wished not to awaken, that this Spiritual Adam became unbreakable.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: And yet, you stand here right now, which also means... that man failed.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Because people must always move towards the future. Even if human weaknesses make them pause, when they truly cannot move forward... humanity will eventually seek a way to save itself.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I had an encounter with this {M#gentleman}{F#lady} in the Golden Hour. I remember that little silver-haired girl was there too...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: And that man... He was NEVER a failure. Like everyone in that world, he etched the possibilities of human nature into his heart.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: He was the {RUBY_B#Icarus}sunchaser{RUBY_E#} of legend, soaring towards the sky, and embracing his final victory with his fall.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: He ascended to heights uncharted, only to come face to face with the sun — a place not visited by anyone before. His wings would melt because of it, only for him to fall into the sea, and after that...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...A fitting metaphor for the Nameless' Trailblazing spirit.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Thank you, Mr. Yang. I know what you wish to confirm. The universe has innumerable similar, yet different worlds. In these worlds, there are innumerable people who look alike, yet don't.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I, too have embarked on journeys, encountering "old friends" with familiar faces on different worlds, witnessing their destinies follow paths similar to mine. So, I will tell you...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Even if not completely similar, this story you just told... It overlaps with my past. And within that abyssal dream...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I am not who you think I am, nor will my home be as fortunate as your world.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: At this moment, on the other side...
...I am sorry.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's fine. I don't mind, so long as I can alleviate your suspicions.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...There's something I still wish to know, Miss Acheron. Under that representation of The Hunt, exactly what sort of power is it that has motivated your solitary journey thus far?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Not possible! It was you the last time, yelling about some clockwork friendship while beating me up with that silver-haired girl!
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: I'm not letting you get by this time... Please leave, or I'll have to get on my knees and beg you!
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: [Trailblazer], what kind of heinous crime have you committed now...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hold on, Sir... We have documents authorized by The Family that would aid your investigation. If it wouldn't trouble you, could we see this Mr. Gallagher?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Who exactly is this Gallagher you keep talking about? There have been a few people mentioning this name, even the one with the gray hair.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Uh? He didn't send you all here?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It was the Security Officer who dispatched us. That's all I can divulge.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: He'll do! He's the one we've been looking for!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sorry, no can do. The boss said that since it's a matter of The Family's reputation, no one's allowed through.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Everyone, please leave. There's really no need for us to make things difficult for each other, right?
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: ...Mr. Yang, before answering that question, I wish to continue the previous topic.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I like your analogy very much. Indeed, birds are born to fly, but in a distant past, their ancestors could only gaze at the sky in envy.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They saw that faraway ray of light from above the heavens, piercing through the clouds and blanketing the earth. And so, time and time again, generation after generation, the birds spread their wings and took to the sky, attempting to touch its ceiling — all because the sun was there.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Am I destined to relive this outcome...? Looks like you and I have been plunged into a cycle of despair.
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: ...What's he talking about?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: However, this time, I will sever the chains of tragedy — the only way any of you will pass, is over my dead body!
rows.speaker: Principled Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: He doesn't have to be so melodramatic, does he?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (Looks like he still doesn't want to budge an inch...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The principled Bloodhound Family member has become unusually gloomy... You have to think of a way to get him to lighten up.
— And then quickly lets go, in the blink of an eye.
Then, what if the last bird finally soars into the sky, only to realize that the end of the light is not the sun, but {RUBY_B#All-Consuming Black Hole}darkness{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Then why exactly... do we even walk towards the light?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Long time no see! Having fun on Penacony, Acheron?
(This voice... It's not Constance. Could it be her companion?)
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Though I don't know exactly what you are or what you're up to...
My bullets will find you — until then, you best find a casket store on Penacony, and ask the owner to reserve a good quality casket for you, imposter!
(Imposter? I see. She gave my whereabouts to someone who is tracking Acheron too.)
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Who are you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Huh? Did I make a mistake? Who the fudge are you?
I'm the Garden of Recollection's Memokeeper.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Heh! Not bad. This is the kind of tough challenge I like. Are you that imposter's bodyguard? Never mind. It's fine. I'll leave a round for you, so get that forehead clean and wait for me!
I don't know what you're talking about — but you know Acheron, the Galaxy Ranger, yes? I have something to ask you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Haha, are you asking me to write your will? Sure, go ahead.
Not quite. I only want to ask, how exactly did she become a Galaxy Ranger?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: She's clearly not a Pathstrider of The Hunt. But you are, aren't you? Tell me, what's Acheron's deal?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Hahahaha, sure! Never thought I'd come across an ally. Fudge, what a stroke of luck!
I'll be on Penacony soon. Memokeeper, go buy a bottle of Asdana's White Oak and warm it up, and I'll raise a glass to you.
That lady's past? Nobody knows. But if all you want is a simple answer, sure, you best get a chair and take a seat. That woman named Acheron...
—is an Emanator who should not exist.
The IPC has announced that its Strategic Investment Department has completed the recovery and remediation of the Chakwakad Chain...
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: The Chakwakad Chain, located in the Acunawakad Sector, was once a vital trading port for the IPC. However, it was captured by the combined forces of the Fitzgerald Paramilitary Navy during the Interstellar Energy War...
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: What was left of the sector became a hub for the Interstellar Slave Market and has fallen into the hands of space pirates, posing a significant threat to trade and shipping in the neighboring sectors...
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: Under the guidance of Jade, an esteemed member of the Strategic Investment Department, the Star Chain has now been returned to its rightful owner. However, the rampant spread of the Interstellar Slave Trade and piracy remains a pressing concern for the IPC. The IPC is fully committed to...
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: You look pale. Or, is that also part of your act?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Didn't think you'd have the nerve to show yourself.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I thought this was exactly what you wanted. After all, I faithfully fulfilled my duties as you instructed.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Just tell me if you can't hold on any longer.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: So, the "genius" of the Council of Mundanites wants to be my undertaker now? My... what an honor.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Yeah, and I'm pretty sure the people at the Strategic Investment Department would love to be notified of your death in due time, but let's not forget you won't be seeing them, because I'm the manager of this task.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Great, then tell your people that Aventurine is ready to go in seventeen system hours.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You've got a lot of nerve — how exactly do you plan on completing your task while your hands are tied by the Harmony?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: My conversation with Sunday convinced me that there's a traitor in The Family, and that they hold the secrets of Penacony... So, I took the opportunity to set everything in motion.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I even managed to recover the gift money. Things haven't gone this smoothly since I walked through the doors of The Reverie... Now, I'm only one step away from victory. Let's just wait and see.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sounds like a very elaborate way of saying that you failed.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: That's all I can say. Have you forgotten, Doctor? You betrayed me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Go, do what you must. I look forward to the sight of the IPC fleet surrounding Penacony. You've achieved what you desired, haven't you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That's true, but what's your plan? Did you conceal an Orbital Support beacon in that gift money bag?
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Well, who knows? Maybe that's why I'm handing out cash even when I'm about to bite the dust.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...You are indeed a gambler — an insane one at that.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Well, maybe I am. Who knows?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Fine. Here, take this. Open it when you're on your last legs. You'll thank me.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: What's this...? Medical advice?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You catch on pretty fast, Doctor.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Asking me to solve a case without giving a single clue... How typical of you, you wing-headed scoundrel.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But the way you're all on edge about that stowaway, it's just as I guessed it would be. As for now... let the rain of wealth from the IPC fall evenly on everyone.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You... Wait, I get it now! This is some sort of prank show, right? You must have some cameras set up around here to film yourself doing good deeds, right?
rows.speaker: Chabro

rows.text: (Ehhh... I can feel something inside my head... Is the "Harmony" starting to kick in?)
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Would you be willing to support my performance, and keep the Song of Beauty alive in the cosmos?
rows.speaker: Larose

rows.text: Wow, how fabulous! But why would you give such a wonderful gift to a random stranger like me?
rows.speaker: Larose

rows.text: (The disturbing voice in my head... it's getting closer.)
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A sip of liquor, a blissful reprieve... To drown a thousand sorrows, let worries leave... Hah, I know I have what it takes to become a poet...
rows.speaker: Bocchi

rows.text: Oh? You... you are giving... these gems to me? Didn't expect to meet such a generous soul in this place...
rows.speaker: Bocchi

rows.text: (Does everyone have to go through so much torment before joining The Family?... Darn it, now I just want to dig out my brain and use it as evidence...)
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Take care, my friend. If you ever find yourself in danger, remember that the Hounds are always ready to help.
rows.speaker: Woolsey

rows.text: You want to talk to me? Sure, but nothing too sensitive, okay?
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: Wealthy people have fancy ways to enjoy this dream, but to be honest, I've never seen anyone who gives out money to others like you.
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: So, are you trying to be the prince from the tale, handing out his gold-leaf garment and melting his lead heart in the fire?
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: Haha, I'm flattered. I'm no prince, and I just thought these gems would help you speak. So, as an investigative reporter, maybe you have heard of something about "Death"?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Another curious soul, I see. Well, that was actually the topic I was most into when I entered the industry, but my boss shut it down.
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: How did your boss talk you out of it?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Well... She simply said, "Covering baseless urban legends like that would make us look like some third-rate tabloid."
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: I thought about it, and she had a point... Reporting on stuff like blowing out birthday candles and getting spooked by nightmare ghosts... isn't exactly professional material.
rows.speaker: Uma

rows.text: Heh, I guess she's got a point... Thank you for sharing.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hmm... Were you wanting to talk to me? Sorry, I thought you were checking out something behind me.
rows.speaker: Barrle

rows.text: Is this... a gift for me? Are you sure this isn't some kind of mistake?
rows.speaker: Barrle

rows.text: (The Devil of SoulGlad, dangers in the dream, and nightmare ghosts... Surely, "Death" is a popular topic in this sweet dream granted by The Family. I've collected a bunch of rumors, but no useful clues...)
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: (The gems in my bag are running low... Let's see if my last lucky interviewee brings some surprises.)
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Here, I got these gems for you.
Remember what I said? You Sigonians are better off hiding in the sewers...
Look at you, snooping around and sticking your nose everywhere...
Is the smell of "Death" so enticing, my fine fellow?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Heh... it's you, Masked Fool. I should have guessed it. You're the "imposter" who appeared on TV after Robin's death, right?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I heard you got caught by The Family? I gave you a clear clue... "Befriend a mute." Simple and straightforward, you know...?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: And what did you do? You messed it up and ended up as their prisoner. I told you to make friends with a mute, not become one yourself. You really let me down.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: ...What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You know better than I do. Who watched the little songbird that couldn't sing perish right before their eyes? You did, Blondie.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: No, I mean... what did you mean by "becoming one myself"?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Well, it means you'll soon end up like her, unable to speak ever again.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: But it's a good thing, if you ask me, because...
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Because I'm getting closer to the truth, right?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Why else do you think I'm handing out cheap trinkets all over the streets, Fool?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: All part of the act. Fool's bait. The more pathetic I seem, the more likely you'll come sniffing around. So. Now that I've drawn you out, will you reward me with an answer for my efforts?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Why should I help you?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Don't you want to see Penacony descend into chaos? Well, I can make it happen. I just need an answer to one question: Back then, when you asked me to find a "mute"...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Did you really mean Robin?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...And what if I say "no"?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Then I'll thank you. The word "no" has never sounded so pleasing.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Well done. I admit I underestimated you, but what difference would it make?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Let me tell you something. There were two mutes, but one is dead now, and the other... Though "she" is still in Penacony, I'm afraid you'll never find "her" again.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Now I'm completely sure that I was on the right track from the beginning and never strayed, Fool.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Right now, there are only two things missing from my grasp: The meaning behind the truth and the means to expose it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: How impressive! That's quite a fancy way of saying "I haven't learned anything so far."
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Not exactly. I've gathered enough clues to prove its existence, and that's enough for me. As for the answers to my questions, I'll find them within seventeen... no, sixteen system hours.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh, really? "Only" sixteen system hours? Well, let me lend you a hand.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Here you go. This is my precious "Mutually Assured Destruction" button, and I have one just like it. When either of us presses it, the other and the whole of Penacony will go up in smoke.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: If you're really so desperate for the IPC to take over Penacony... blowing up the chessboard isn't a bad idea. Start from scratch! That's where the IPC excels, right?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Just press the button when you're at your wit's end. And of course, feel free to reach out to me for my "hospice care" too!
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: A deadly button, huh?... I guess The Family didn't take your threats seriously at all? Otherwise, how on earth did you manage to bring it in here?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I have my own ways. That's all you need to know.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: I'm afraid I'll have to decline your offer. Who knows if your little gadget will actually work? By the way, I have no plans to search for the other mute friend you speak of, but it's good to hear that he's still here in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'll handle the rest myself. I'll orchestrate a grand finale for the downfall of The Family. And at the climax, the walls will crumble, people will wake up, and those who couldn't speak will find their voices again...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: When that time comes, go ahead and press the button, and light up the sky with a magnificent fireworks display for me. Catch you later, Fool.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're still talking big... But sure, if that happens, I'll stay true to my word.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Just don't let me down now, okay?
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: So, No. 35, you're back. Like your new lucky charm?
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: ...Can a "commodity code" really be considered a lucky charm?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Silence. I didn't give you permission to speak, you Sigonian hound.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: The guys in black didn't say much, so I've no idea what you did to save your skin in that massacre back in the day.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: But I figured you must have had good luck, so I bought you. From now on, you and your good luck are MY assets. Are we clear?
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: Your first task is simple. In addition to you, I've purchased thirty... well, thirty-four other slaves.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: Go and play a "game" with them. If you come out alive after two days, it proves that you're the real deal.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: ...You're insane.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Heh, testing out if you're a good product.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: Aren't you worried that the money you spent on me will go to waste?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I've got stacks on stacks, blondie. The slave market is never short of self-righteous brats like you.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: But you look good, and that's why many customers are betting their fortunes on a scrawny brat like you. So, go along now, and don't let your master down.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: ...How much did you spend?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What?
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: My price. How much did you pay for me?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Huh, you really want to know? Well, it was sixty {RUBY_B#Red Copper Coins}Tanba{RUBY_E#}. No more, no less.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: ...I'll take my chances.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Thirty Tanba... If I come back alive, you'll give me thirty Tanba. Deal?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hahaha, are you trying to strike a bet with me? Well, you've got some guts!
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: Sorry, but that won't do. Don't forget your place, slave. You're not qualified to be at the table.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: You're just a chip, a life thrown away in someone else's hands. Either you come back with more chips for your master, or... you never come back.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: It's all or nothing. Don't embarrass me, my lucky hound.
rows.speaker: Indifferent Male

rows.text: What brings you here, Gallagher?
Some friends from the old days. Do you have a moment to spare, Siobhan?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I have the whole day to spare. Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Dreamjolt Hostelry!
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: This bar offers a wide variety of drinks, but we draw the line at SoulGlad. Why settle for ordinary when you can experience extraordinary? We're dedicated to serving up nothing but pure joy and laughter.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: What would you like to drink? I'll whip it up for you.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: That being said, mixing a drink is way simpler than you'd imagine. Just pick your favorite ingredients, toss them in a glass, mix it up, and it's done.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: So go ahead, explore the bar and bring me any ingredients you prefer.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I've gathered all the ingredients I need.
I'll come back later.
Nice work. Let me take a look...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Go ahead, my friend. I'm sure you'll find splendid ingredients.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Look, [Trailblazer]! A lady as cool as Serval!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who's Serval? Will you introduce me to her?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Oops, she's heard us...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just spare them, my esteemed bartender. I'll take over the bar today.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Siobhan just said, "Anything can be imbibed"... Perhaps you can try various experiments to see what different emotions can brew with different drink ingredients.
(She's still not leaving... Maybe I'll have to try again.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Things might get out of control if she gets any angrier... I need to come up with another plan.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: A security officer and a derelict lounge... Interesting.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm getting up there in age, and I need some practice before I forget the skills that used to put food on my table. Where did you stash the ingredients?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: They're all under the counter. Since our guests have traveled from afar, shouldn't you whip up some special drinks?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: That's exactly what I had in mind. Hey, my friends, do me a favor. Go around the bar and bring me any ingredients you fancy.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The discussion might take quite some time, so I'll prepare some customized, non-alcoholic drinks for you.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: In the bar? But aren't all the ingredients right there on the counter?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why, we're in a dream, my lovely lady. You can help yourself to anything if you wish for it — comfort, hunger, confusion, or even boredom... It's all within reach, right at your fingertips.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Did you hear that! She just called me "my lovely lady"...!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Even in reality, mixing drinks is more than just throwing ingredients together. A bartender needs to capture the bar's atmosphere, master technique, and spin a tale of mystery and anticipation...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You put "Praise of High Morals" into the empty cup in a metaphysical manner...
You put 50,000 credits into the empty cup
You put a bag of trash into the empty cup
Only then can a perfect drink, crafted with the customer's life story, be created.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: In other words, what you get from your drink is down to luck. So don't overthink it. Indecisiveness has no place when it comes to enjoyment.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: And let me tell you, don't underestimate the bartenders of Penacony, especially not Gallagher. This guy is pure magic... He can satisfy even the pickiest of customers.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Don't go easy on this old man. Give him a real challenge.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: That's possible. You see SoulGlad everywhere these days, so it wouldn't be a surprise if someone brought a bottle here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah, perhaps. SoulGlad is a classic in Penacony, and it'd be strange for a bar not to have it.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh-huh! I... Let's just leave it here for a while... and it'll be alright, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why don't they sell SoulGlad in this bar? Did something happen?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nah, it turned out to be a landslide victory.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Haha, that's a clever metaphor.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: That being said, opening a bar in this place... filled with monsters... is quite a feat. Siobhan must have a lot of tricks up her sleeve, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's quite a stash! Not sure if it's enough...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Stay out of my way! I'm looking for Siobhan!
Huh, what's all the commotion about?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Haven't I made myself clear enough, Ms. Amiky? The Dreamjolt Hostelry only welcomes guests who want to enjoy a drink to their heart's content. I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in your proposal.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: But you have the talent! You'll attract a huge audience... You're destined for the Iris' stage, not for this run-down shack!
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: Come with me! We'll become the talk of Penacony, shining light into every corner of the Dreamscape! Please, Siobhan, I really need you...
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: ...As you see, I'm entertaining my guests. Don't make me repeat myself.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Fine... If you don't come along, I'll just sit here and not go anywhere else. Give me a sparkling drink, sweet, with extra ice.
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: Just one moment.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: What's her deal...? We can't discuss the case with other people hanging around the bar.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], can you do that clockwork trick of yours again...?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Time is running out. We need to hurry.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yeah, I'm counting on you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're one of Siobhan's guests, right? What can I do for you? If you're here to convince me to leave, please stop it. I'll never leave until she accepts my proposal...
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: I just don't get why she won't leave this place... this run-down shack with no customers whatsoever.
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: Well... talking to you has got me feeling a bit down. My thoughts are swirling, making my mind clear and bringing tears to my eyes...
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: Maybe... I should find a place to reflect on what Siobhan truly means to me...
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: Here's the payment for the drinks. Please pass it on to her. I'm leaving now.
rows.speaker: Amiky

rows.text: ...Amiky has left?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: When you're ready, go to Gallagher. I can tell he's itching to show off his skills.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Ugh... the syrup has turned clumpy... I definitely don't want to drink this even if it's not expired.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's true, but this... really doesn't seem fresh...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did you find the bottle of syrup I've been hoarding? Don't worry, it's all just a dream, and it won't upset your stomach. It's been aging for years, and should have a refined taste by now. Feel free to have some. It's perfect for entertaining lovely guests like you.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: {RUBY_B#The Harmony}Concentric circles{RUBY_E#}... May you always remember where you started.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: A {RUBY_B#Hanunue}symbol{RUBY_E#} of bravery and dauntlessness. May you break free from your shackles just like he did.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The IPC's favorite... Ambitious, aren't you?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Well, it's done...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Alright, let's start with what we know based on the clues The Family has. It seems that Firefly isn't a local or an invited guest. In other words... she's a stowaway.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: She managed to fool me at first — my age must be getting the best of me. But here, on the Planet of Festivities, stowaways are a common sight. You're bound to run into one sooner or later. After the incident, the Hounds wasted no time searching for that girl in both the Dreamscape and reality.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: But here's the thing... We only received bad news, and the trickiest kind at that.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: She simply vanished, leaving no trace in the Dreamscape or reality, as if she had never come to Penacony at all.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Huh? Does that mean...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's impossible. The problem now is not that she's dead, but that it's as if she had never existed in the first place.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Different...? Are you suggesting that girl wasn't actually killed? Come on, aren't you a witness in this case?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Haha, a clever metaphor... Um, you were making a metaphor, right?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Let me be frank... This case, actually... is unlike anything the Bloodhound Family has dealt with before.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: "Dealt with before"? So... "Death" does happen in Penacony, if I understand correctly?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You've witnessed it, so there's no need to hide. Even the shiniest city has its dark side. We're all adults here, surely I don't need to explain too much to you.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Confronting The Family based on that alone would be naive. Death may occur in sweet dreams — so what? Such events are highly unlikely and only affect a tiny number of people.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: If you really want to delve deeper into this case, you need to understand the true "problem" with The Family.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I guess it's time to tell the story of that "Mikhail."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're very perceptive. The Astral Express has received that music box, too, right? Do you know the secrets it holds?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: There's a message. "...Witness the impossible in the realm of dreams, find the Legacy of the Watchmaker, Father of Penacony, and thus the answer to the question: Why does life slumber?"
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: *sigh* That's good for her... Radiant dreams may be enticing, but they're nothing more than dreams. Her drink is on the house. Please keep the money.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: That's the exact wording.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Hey, why are you laughing... Wait, did you write it? It's quite poetic.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No... but I'm the officer in charge of this case, and how could I not know?... I'm sure you must have noticed that this message didn't come from The Family. You might even have guessed that the relationship between The Family and the Watchmaker isn't as close as it seems?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: That's just our speculation. Actually, it's hard to believe that the {RUBY_B#The Watchmaker}Father of Penacony{RUBY_E#} and its {RUBY_B#The Family}actual managers{RUBY_E#} are at odds.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Now I can assure you that your speculation is absolutely correct.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The Family has considered the Watchmaker as an enemy for a long time, but the Hounds haven't been able to track him down, as he seems to be living only in the characters and stories he created.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Let me ask you a question: Have you ever wondered why The Family allowed the Watchmaker to send out such a ridiculous message to the outside world, inviting you here and causing chaos?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: So, you want to seize this opportunity to expose the Watchmaker?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Well, now you understand why the Oak Family authorized the Nameless to assist in the investigation but kept you in the dark, right?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Because the Watchmaker is not the legend of the Land of the Dreams at all. He's the most shameful stain in the history of Penacony, and he's the root cause of all the anomalies in the Dreamscape.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You don't get it? Well, I mean...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Mikhail, the betrayer of The Family... He's the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Here we are, Clock Studios Theme Park, the most popular entertainment center in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Wait, aren't we supposed to be discussing "The Watchmaker"? I would have expected you to take us to maybe a library or an archive room of sorts, but an amusement park...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The culture of a city reflects its history in the most authentic way. To you, it's a fun place, but to me, it's a prison for the planet's past.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You know that Penacony used to be the IPC's prison planet, right? All the prisoners were brought here, helping the Garden of Recollection salvage the leaking memoria from the Macro Void...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The prolonged exposure to high concentrations of memoria caused a unique phenomenon. The dreams of countless prisoners intersected and overlapped, and people started meeting each other in their dreams, living lives that were almost identical to reality.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: But everything has a price, and sweet dreams are no exception. In the end, the dream world was unable to alleviate the suffering of prisoners in reality. One of the prisoners broke free from the IPC's shackles and fought for freedom...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...He is {RUBY_B#Hanunue}Hanu{RUBY_E#}, the great leader of Dreamville, the great peacemaker, and the faithful companion of the underdogs.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: History is always written by the winners. However, it's undeniable that Clockie is an animation that draws from Penacony's actual history.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: These characters not only exist in Dreamville but also in the distant past. Once you realize this... you'll understand why we're here.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: There are so many members of the Bloodhound Family around here...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They just received a lockdown order, supposedly from Sunday himself. Who knows what it's for.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Heh... so many of them... I've never seen anything like this, even when they're tracking down suspects.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Some time later...
We don't need to go in — we don't want to draw any unwanted attention inside. We can just talk here.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Well, it's a masterpiece from The Family after all. Besides the followers of the Preservation, The Family members are the best at creating mind-blowing marvels.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Let's find a quiet spot and continue our conversation.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Well, that's one way to look at it. However, only one member has truly inherited the Watchmaker's title.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Unfortunately, after all these years, I have no idea who that person is, or if they're even real... or just Mikhail's lost soul haunting the dreams.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: So, do you understand why I'm spilling all this info...? Because I believe the girl's death must be connected to the Watchmaker's Legacy, and at the end of all these mysteries...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...We will find the answers we are seeking.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: If it really is Mikhail's ghost, I want to meet him, if only for the last time. Those who despise me could form a line from here all the way to the entrance of the hotel, but those willing to look me in the eye and hear me out... Let's just say, there won't be many.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I've told you all I know as a sign of gratitude. Thank you for listening to this old dog — bark and all.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The view here is great, right? We can see everything from here...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Including Clockie.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: If all the characters in the animation are based on characters in reality, then Clockie's counterpart is definitely the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: In the animation, he's Hanu's partner and one of the founders of Dreamville. Does that mean the Watchmaker was personally involved in that war and sided with Asdana?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It was a monumental war for freedom. Hanunue fought alongside a motley crew of Masked Fools, Nameless, History Fictionologists, Mourning Actors, Omen Vanguards... even visitors from beyond the sky. In the end, they emerged victorious.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Among them was the person who would eventually be known as the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: But if you do the math... doesn't that mean the Watchmaker was around for several centuries?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm not sure, but Mikhail was already the Watchmaker when I met him, so maybe he inherited the title.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...How old are you now, Mr. Officer?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...I'm thirteen.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: No way! Not even close!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hanunue freed the frontier prison, but peace still eluded him. With limited resources, threats from the outside world, and internal conflicts between major prison districts, the future of Asdana was uncertain.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: It wasn't until the Watchmaker approached The Family with the idea of turning the prison into the Planet of Festivities... that Penacony finally gained its name and glory.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Thus he became known as the Father of Penacony.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But didn't you say the Watchmaker betrayed The Family? And you said you were his companion, so that means you...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No, I'm not his "companion," but rather one of his many "children."
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: But I am indeed a traitor. Not to The Family, but to... Mikhail.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...What did you do?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I did nothing... and that's the worst betrayal of all.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Just like you, I had close companions. We dedicated ourselves to Penacony, but the Oak Family... they set us up.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Mikhail was too old to protect his children anymore, so we left The Family to find our own path. We were branded traitors of the Harmony, even though the true traitors were someone else.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: While they continue to praise the Watchmaker's name to the world, behind closed doors they condemn him on a pillar of shame.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Nevertheless, we wanted to clear his name. We intended to find the real traitor, the one responsible for all this, and restore Harmony to Penacony...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...But we failed. Too much time had passed, and the Land of the Dreams had become deeply corrupted. After countless fruitless pursuits, I gave up... like a lost dog.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: The Family accepted me and made me an officer, supposedly as a form of forgiveness, but it was actually a punishment. Since then, I've been completely cut off from my partners... and my past. As for Mikhail...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...I heard he died in obscurity, in a place where no one could find him. That's when I realized that the Penacony I once knew would never return.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: We're truly sorry for what happened... but this is not the end of the story, right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hmm... Apparently, someone has inherited the title of the Watchmaker and has been secretly working against The Family all this time.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Hmm? Something just happened at the theme park... Now, if you'll excuse me. Good luck to all of you.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: How ironic. What's so different between the stowaways rejected by Penacony today and the dream seekers once hailed as pioneers several Amber Eras ago?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Gallagher... does have a troubled past, it seems.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: While Firefly's whereabouts remain a mystery, his stories shed light on our suspicions about the true identity of the Watchmaker, his connection to The Family, and the power struggles hidden behind sweet dreams and death.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Exactly. Gallagher suggests that the real traitor is someone else... probably within the Oak Family.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That lines up with what we've gathered so far. Firefly got involved in this mess because of the Legacy... And now we're sure that Aventurine's accusations against Acheron are baseless.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...You're really into Clockie, huh? He's just a fictional character, not a real person!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Speaking of which, that Clockie who only reveals himself to [Trailblazer] is quite intriguing... It's a shame we've never met him since then.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Now that we've confirmed a lot of our suspicions, let's take a moment to think about the clues we have. [Trailblazer], send a message to Welt and see how things are going on his end.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Are your companions worried about you?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They're just checking up on me. Let's get in and get out — it seems they've made some progress.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Looks like we're about to enter the depths of Dewlight Pavilion.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's been a smooth ride... almost too smooth for a heavily guarded mansion.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Let's see if there's anyone waiting to greet us.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Something feels off... A grand mansion like this and not a butler or servant in sight... Could it be due to the disruption caused by the emergency?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...This door is open — looks like we'll have to investigate ourselves. Let's proceed with caution.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Just one moment.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Bated Breath}"White"{RUBY_E#}... I've made myself less noticeable. The Crew can explain their presence as authorized by The Family, but I can't come up with any excuses for being here.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I see. What an interesting technique.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The model in the sandpit... it's the Golden Hour, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Maybe the heads of The Family use that model for discussing important matters.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The footprints here are different from the rest... there are two sets of them. Looks like outsiders might have passed through here not long ago.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Can you identify the people who left these footprints?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Well... there's a unique pattern here — flamboyant even. And judging by the size, I'd say these were men's shoes.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: According to Robin's interview, despite having performed on so many grand stages, her favorite performance was a pretend show she put on with her brother when they were just kids.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: If I'm right... it could be the IPC ambassador, Aventurine.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Aventurine... What about the other set?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It looks like they were walking side by side as opposed to one behind the other — so the second individual is likely equal in status to Aventurine.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...The IPC is eager to reclaim Penacony, so their presence here is not unexpected.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Look, it dropped something.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: A... note? Looks like instructions from the butler for the other servants.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Seems like the mansion's entire workforce were assigned other tasks... before Robin's death.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...It must have been a big project to require that much manpower... the "Charmony Festival," perhaps.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But no matter what their main priorities are, there should always be someone left at the mansion, right?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: So, you're saying... someone deliberately cleared the place out?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yeah, but I don't know why.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...No one here either.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Since no one's around to entertain us, let's make ourselves at home. Stay close to me so that my "White" can cover you, too.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: As soon as I and the rest of the Crew arrived in Penacony, Mr. Sunday and Robin showed up to greet us. I remember hearing something unusual in her voice... and now it seems I was right.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Robin believed it was because the Harmony had been tampered with somehow, but as far as I know, there aren't many entities capable of interfering with the power of Paths.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Meaning...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: If there really is a traitor within The Family... that person must hold a high position or possess unimaginable strength.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Acheron draws her blade slightly. Within a moment, her breath became imperceptible.
That would explain why Mr. Sunday has been having such difficulty in catching the traitor.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The information about Robin, Firefly... and the other victims... I don't see any commonalities among them.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Looks like the rumors were right — "Death" does seem to be targeting random victims. And based on Sunday's notes... he's no stranger to "Death."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: He's just surprised that it has resurfaced.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: This Light Cone... is securely guarded. It must hold some important memories.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I wonder how their relationship is now.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Growing up brings gains, but also losses.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yeah, time has a way of smoothing things out. The beautiful dreams of youth... will eventually fade away.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It seems neither the Dreammaster of Penacony nor this Old Oti is happy with Sunday's recent performance.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: They don't seem to care much about "Death"... Instead, they're more concerned about the Charmony Festival and the Watchmaker.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Maybe the other family heads don't think "Death" is a big deal... One thing's for sure — there's a lot of internal conflict within The Family, and everybody has their own agenda.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mr. Sunday has done some serious research on his suspects... This traitor must have been causing trouble for The Family for a long time.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They all seem to be insiders... but I haven't met any of them.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Huh? Wait, these characteristics...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What is it?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: No, nothing... Maybe I'm just overthinking things... However, if this traitor really exists, could they be responsible for Firefly and Robin's deaths?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Perhaps that's why Sunday is taking this matter so seriously.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That's all for now... Nothing more noteworthy.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Before coming here, I had all sorts of scenarios in my head about dealing with The Family... I did not expect an empty mansion...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Watch out. Someone's approaching.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I don't think trespassing on forbidden areas is the way to be a guest, Mr. Yang, and...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Acheron, the Galaxy Ranger?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Our apologies, Mr. Sunday. Nobody came to greet us, so we entered without permission. I hope you can forgive us.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But even if there's no one to greet you, you should wait for the host, don't you agree?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Even without the famous Galaxy Ranger... as far as I know, the Crew has officially accepted The Family's commission, so coming here will be unnecessary for you.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: On the contrary, that's exactly why we're here. To ask you about the case and gather more information — we don't want any loose ends.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Well, since you've come with goodwill, I have no reason to show you the door.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Rest assured... He hasn't figured out that we went through those documents.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: While the truth remains a mystery, I'm getting close to it. I assure you that the traitor will soon pay the price.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Let's hope justice will prevail soon. I have a question for you, if you don't mind: How did The Family come to the conclusion that the murderer was within The Family?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: With all due respect, it's in the IPC's interest to wreak havoc before the Charmony Festival... and The Family has every reason to suspect the IPC's involvement.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Well, other family heads share the same suspicions as you, but in my opinion, the true murderer would never have drawn as much attention as that ambassador did... Not to mention I personally shackled him a while ago.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: However, I'll give you a suggestion regarding your suspicions, Mr. Yang. You should be more cautious of Aventurine... While the wicked can't break through high walls, they can plunge their evil dagger into the heart of the righteous.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: He's a businessman, not some philanthropist. But right now, he's out there handing out his wealth on the streets, and he went to the Clock Studios Theme Park all by himself. Who knows what kind of scheme he's cooking up...?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: While The Family is dedicated to keeping our guests safe, it might be wise for you to stay alert.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: You never know... what unexpected troubles could arise.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "...According to a Pier Point hotline tip, there was a major breakthrough in the shocking Egyhazo Aventurine case. The suspect has been arrested..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "This fraud case has been linked to many departments within the Interastral Peace Corporation and the Intelligentsia Guild, causing a large drain in manpower and resources, resulting in the IPC taking a massive loss..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "The case's main suspect originates from Sigonia-IV, and is one of the survivors of the Second Katica-Avgin Extinction Event, who does not carry an Interstellar Refugee Travel Permit..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "As per Strategic Investment Department head Diamond's sentiments, the IPC has appropriately relocated the suspect in the spirit of the Charter, and will continue to conduct further investigations as to the motive of the suspect..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: What pretty eyes. Tell me, do they shine in the dark?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Well if they did, I'd sell them in a heartbeat.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: You don't know how many people long for your eyes to be closed forever. As a servant, you should not resist your master... Yet you went and killed that man anyway.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: No lawyer has the audacity to defend you, perhaps you ought to represent yourself?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Not difficult. But definitely pointless.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: You're pretty confident on your eloquence. Did you also think that when you lied to the Intelligentsia Guild?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Ask and you shall receive. You wanted the perfect construction material — all I did was offer a possibility. It was just a small wager.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: If your luck holds out, the IPC will dig something up from the golden sands of Egyhazo, maybe even the {RUBY_B#Tayzzyronth}Sand King's{RUBY_E#} remains. Pity, your luck has run out.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: I'll admit that. What I'm more curious about though, is why such a grand scheme failed to benefit anyone in the end, including the perpetrator himself?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Madam, I already have what I want — to be brought before you, for the next high-stakes gamble.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Then let's talk about the second gamble. Tell me, what are you prepared to wager this time?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: My life. I bet you won't send me to the gallows.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Hmm... What do you want then?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I want your {RUBY_B#chief}lanor{RUBY_E#} to meet with me. I have something to say.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: And then what?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I want cash.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: It can't be that simple, can it?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It is that simple. Thirty {RUBY_B#Red Copper Coins}Tanbas{RUBY_E#} — the remainder of my... market value. Thirty Tanbas, no more, no less.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: With this money, I'll climb to even greater heights than you, grasp even more riches than you... I wager you won't give me this chance... which is why you should call him here.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Interesting.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: A pity Diamond won't see you. No one gets to see him. From here on out, I am Diamond's representative, and I will decide on his behalf.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: You're wrong. Thirty Tanbas... I'll give you that, and much more than that. Wealth, status, power... the IPC will give you whatever you want, even what you don't want.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Kakavasha... A good name, but unfortunately destined to be buried in the dirt. You though, you deserve to live, to create even more wealth for us.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Go, pick the clothes you like, then choose your desired identity... and then use them well, child.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: May your schemes be forever concealed.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Life is like a long-term investment. Those who choose correctly, do the correct things, reach the correct outcomes, show the world their value.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: People can't always make the right choices in their lives, but luck has always been on my side. I've never lost.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Is it because Gaiathra blesses me? If that's the case, she must also be looking upon me right now. My success is inevitable.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...But, what then?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Even if I overcome this difficult trial, what would come next? What awaits me after this glorious gamble... an even more glorious one?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Will I return triumphant with unending riches after countless successes, or will I encounter failure...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...never to return?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I'm pretty sure you already have some ideas...
...Lowly gambler?
First I'm hearing things, and now I'm seeing them. Great! Am I going to be elevated into the Harmony's Emanator next?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Why are there no guests here? What's that feather-head doing?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Those eyes... and Mama Fenge... No! It can't...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: There AREN'T any Avgins left!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Papa, Mama, wait for me...
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: ...It's not going to be me anyway.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The cornerstone is gone... Another illusion of the Harmony.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Huh?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Hello, we meet again, Mr. Pretty-eyes.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: ...Yes, we meet again. Did you find your mother and father?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Of course, Big Sis is there too. The four of us were just playing hide-and-seek.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: I'm so happy! On our way here, Papa even brought me to see a flim.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: I think you mean "film."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Yes, that's it. Putting many drawings together and turning them into a moving wall painting.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: They put me, Papa, Mama and Big Sis together, turning us into one big family.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: You should give it a try too, Mister! You look sad. The amusement park will cheer you up.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: ...Sure.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: How's that? Not a bad score, eh?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Boring.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It's so quiet this time. Is he finally gone...? Or am I the one about to disappear?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Finally... made it out of this place.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It's so fun here... I want to stay here forever...
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Brother Hanu! Where... are you going?
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: There's only one place he can be going, whether it's in the past, present or future!
rows.speaker: Boss Stone

rows.text: I thought minors weren't allowed in Golden Hour... Hey kid, are you okay? Are you lost—
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: — Ugh!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What's wrong, Mister... You don't look well.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Your... eyes?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Impossible. Who are you?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: They're pretty, aren't they? Sis said they're a gift from {RUBY_B#Gaiathra}Mama Fenge{RUBY_E#}. Colorful eyes are said to bring good luck.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Ah, Mister... You have pretty eyes too. Beautiful!
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Are... you alone? Where are your parents?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: They're in that amusement park. Papa and Mama went in first. I'm just about to go look for them.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: I have to go, goodbye Mister. Hope you have a good time too!
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Beautiful dream's about to end! The beautiful dream will never end!
rows.speaker: Origami Bird

rows.text: Mister... Is that you? I hear the sound of leather shoes.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: Ah... It really is you.
rows.speaker: Young Child

rows.text: So you're an actor... No wonder your clothes are so stylish.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: I'm actually a... merchant. But I do have a show to do.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Are you the same as those men in black in the sky? But you're not wearing black.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Only ordinary employees have to wear that. My position... is much higher than theirs.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Awesome, I hope I can become as good-looking as you when I grow up.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Of course you can.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You'll be better, and stronger than me.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Behind this curtain is the grand stage...
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: How nice! Now I can see what I look like too.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Look at the lens when you're taking a photo the next time — your expression will look more natural.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sure, I will. Then... Mister, are you going back too?
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: I can't leave yet.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I still have... a show to do.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Oh... You're about to go on stage, aren't you?
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"
