rows.text: Let's go then. I'll take you to the stage.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: It's almost time to go on stage. Are you ready? Good luck with your show.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Thank you.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You still seem pretty nervous...
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Let's put our palms together. If you receive Gaiathra's blessing, you'll feel more relaxed.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: Putting our palms together is a simple ritual. By putting our palms together and reciting the prayer to Mama Fenge, she will bless us.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: If you are not familiar, I can guide you.
rows.speaker: "Kakavasha"

rows.text: It's alright. I know how to do it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Of course I know.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This is where we go our own way, Kakavasha. The Katicans are coming.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: Why? The Katicans have already taken all our money, food, and they killed our parents... What more do they want?
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: Katicans are bloodthirsty, cruel, and insatiably greedy. They want everything, only to end up with nothing.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: This is a trick, an act of revenge. Remember? Today is the day of the Kakava, and also your birthday.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: They know the Avgin will surely hold a festival today. With the aid of this rain, they will come to destroy our wagons and take everything they want.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: Little do the Katicans know, this time we will fight back! The men in black that descend from the skies are on our side. The Katicans stand no chance against them and will surely pay for their arrogance.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: Without this rain, the Katicans would never take action, and we would not have the chance to turn the tide. This is a gift from Gaiathra, and you are {RUBY_B#Child Blessed by Gaiathra}Kakavasha{RUBY_E#}, whose good fortune will bless your sister with success.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: But... but people will die, and you will be in danger... How is that good fortune? Why are you all doing this...
rows.speaker: Kakavasha

rows.text: The Avgin always return their blood debts. Gaiathra calls for me, while Papa and Mama are waiting for me. I must answer the call. But she will bless you with good fortune and help you survive.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: As long as you are alive, the blood of the Avgin will never run dry. So run, Kakavasha, do not be afraid, and do not look back. Go to the other side of the mountain. The rain will accompany you, and the rain will bless you.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: As for us, we will reunite in {RUBY_B#Start of Gaiathra Reincarnation}Kakava{RUBY_E#}'s next aurora.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: "May the goddess Gaiathra close her eyes three times..."
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: "Keep your blood eternally pulsing..."
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: "Let your journey be forever peaceful... "
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: "...and your schemes forever concealed."
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: Farewell, Kakavasha.
rows.speaker: Kakavasha's Sister

rows.text: "Newsflash from the Interastral Peace Broadcast: The IPC Marketing Development Department's spokesperson confirms that a small-scale rebellion has broken out in the unclaimed region of Sigonia. The situation is now under control..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "The insurgents are from a local clan known as Katica, which has a long history of disdain towards the IPC. This has caused a serious negative impact to the work of the IPC's Marketing Development Department..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "The clan launched a massive attack on the Avgin, who were under the protection of the IPC, resulting in 6,728 deaths and 3,452 missing. The casualties are currently under the care of the Frontline Trauma Team..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "The spokesperson expresses his deepest condolences for this devastating humanitarian disaster, at the same time delivering an important message on this matter to all interplanetary citizens..."
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: "Finally, he proclaims: 'The hammer of Preservation will fall for all beings, regardless of life or death, regardless of race, regardless of ideology, to uphold the basic rights we inherently possess.'"
rows.speaker: Interastral Peace Broadcast

rows.text: ...Bye.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Okay, all the actors are in place. It's time for the show to begin.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Kakavasha?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This act is dedicated to you. I hope it'll be an unforgettable memory for you...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: By the way, before you go, I have a personal question.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Kakavasha.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You... do you truly want to destroy the world with your own hands?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Let's assume — just assuming, now — that every time I roll the dice, there is a possibility of achieving this particular outcome...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Then, I would be quite happy to make that wager.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Is this Miss Acheron? Hello, I'm Himeko, the Astral Express' navigator.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hello, I'm March 7th! I'm sure [Trailblazer] needs no introduction, as you definitely know {F#her}{M#him}.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer] is right. No matter what, we cannot ignore the safety of Penacony.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer] also makes a good point. We're completely in the dark on what's going to happen next...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But, I think we can't just ignore the safety of Penacony.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're talking weird again... But it's a good vibe. No matter what, we can't ignore the safety of Penacony.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Meanwhile — Memory Zone Depths
You try to open your eyes, but find only blackness before you.
Mm... I have a bad feeling that something big's gonna go down. [Trailblazer], are you ready?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ready.
Wait...

Memories gradually resurface as time rewinds to a few minutes ago: Aventurine unleashes the final assault, pouring down a dazzling shower of chips, followed closely by Acheron drawing her blade, and then, *crash*—

The indescribable force severs the power of Preservation, while time and space froze instantly. Your thoughts twist into a knot as your senses fail, with only gravity tearing at your mind as you plummet into boundless darkness...
...until a fire engulfs you in its embrace.
Let's waste no time and head to the theme park then!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Your trauma isn't getting to you, is it... Take it easy. It'll be fine.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Mr. Yang.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Why did you not tell your companions about my true identity?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's just like you said: An inability rather than an unwillingness. Plus it's a long story... not something that can be summed up in a few words.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But I chose to believe you, and my trust in you stems more from... my own personal judgment.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thank you, I'm grateful.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: To reciprocate, in the upcoming confrontation, if the odds aren't in the Astral Express' favor... I will stand with you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...If my meager strength is required.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We're back here again. Aventurine actually chose a really conspicuous location...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hello. None of you seem surprised by my arrival.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That guy's really taking it to a whole new level. Does he really think he's a superstar or something?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Not a soul in sight? The Hounds drove out the visitors, and now their whereabouts are unknown too...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Everyone, pay attention. The other party has obviously come prepared.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: To solve the mystery of the Watchmaker, it is crucial to get the IPC's intel. The path ahead is fraught with danger... but what's Trailblazing without a little danger?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ladies, gentlemen, dream seekers, tycoons, esteemed guests of the Watchmaker and The Family...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Also not forgetting the Nameless of the renowned Astral Express! Welcome to the Interastral Peace Corporation's live show!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Astral Express, you're late, and this... "unsought guest."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: We've kept your appointment, Mr. Aventurine. It is customary to show yourself as well.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I will, naturally. But before that, I've got to introduce our guest of honor.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let me remind you that in all likelihood, this stage and {F#her}{M#his} identity have nothing to do with the wanted murderer.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Oh no, they do, of course they do. Otherwise, why would I work so hard to gain your trust and then invite you all here?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Three homicides?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That's right, madam — the third one is about to happen right now, right here in Clock Studios Theme Park...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A truly grand death.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...You will become the personification of "Death."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Since Welt has decided to travel with you, it means that he trusts you, and we trust his judgment.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I envy your close friendships.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Miss Acheron here doesn't present a danger, and she's of no threat to the Astral Express. Aventurine's prior accusation was based on nothing more than his own subjectivity.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Which is why, before we continue working together, he has a duty to explain himself.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: You want to... create a situation where all three parties are present?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: There must be some deeper meaning behind Aventurine's actions. I suspect he's been aware of Penacony's secret from the beginning... and has been continuously strategizing to unveil it.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: In that sense, the Astral Express' role in his plans would be imperative. In the worst case scenario... he may use us to do something unexpected.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Assuming things do escalate to that stage, having an extra ally is a good insurance policy. Penacony has numerous factions, and the state of affairs is significantly more intricate than that of Belobog and the Xianzhou.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I thought my intent was crystal clear...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Sounds like we've reached a consensus. Now... Miss Acheron?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I will accompany you, of course.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Let's move out then! But... where do we start looking for him?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No need to rush. If he truly has laid a trap... he will definitely use every means to lure us in.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ladies and gentlemen...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The most wondrous, most magnificent show in Penacony's history is about to begin...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The IPC cordially invites everyone to — Clock Studios Theme Park!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Look.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Should both the performers and spectators fail to arrive, won't all of Aventurine's plans be for nothing?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Let's get going, everyone. The hour of trailblazing is upon us.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Don't underestimate the Preservation. The cornerstone of the Amber Lord will surely guide me...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Never underestimate yourself. Like I said, you have the power to turn the tide on the entire game...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Let me be a little clearer: I will detonate the Stellaron in you, and cause a teeny-tiny accident on Penacony...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Bam! The entire theme park will be reduced to a shattered dream. Then, before The Family can even react, I'll become the IPC fleet's navigator.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Your bluff isn't fooling anyone. If you could really do that, you would have done so earlier.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You wanna bet? Sure, I'll bet with you. I'm betting that it'll be a sweeping victory for me, by detonating an unprecedented explosion to prove that the vow of Harmony is a complete and utter joke.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...You won't do it.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Everyone give it up for... {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Stellaron!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Of course I can. It's just another gamble.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Because {F#she}{M#he} is the only one who saw all three homicides. {F#She}{M#He} is the key to proving that The Family's "death does not exist in dreams" promise is nothing but a sham!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I came from the wastelands of Sigonia. For just sixty red copper coins, people paid to brand me, put me in chains, place me in the gallows, and bury me in the golden sands...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But the sun could not kill me, and the quicksand sent me back to the embrace of the Guild and the IPC. Bear in mind, my victory wasn't just a stroke of luck — I've never been defeated.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Have you ever heard the saying "Sleep is the rehearsal of death"? Why does life slumber? All because we are not ready for the final rest.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You, you, you, and you... All of you are going to die! And it's all because of you, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Stellaron...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Every night is practice for the end. You and I are escaping into our dreams for fear of death at this very moment. And "Death"... will surface in our dreams.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Friends, the game has commenced, and you cannot choose to decline...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...Nor do you have any reason or grounds to.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You're... leaving?
Mhmm.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Perhaps... I might pass through the place you mentioned.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Penacony...
What do you hope to find within a dream?
I'm not looking for anything.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They aren't in a dream.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I'm afraid The Family will not open the doors for you.
Why?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Because the path you walk... is not accepted by the Harmony.
Even if... that's not what I want?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Precisely because it's not what you want. Because THEY are not like other Aeons.
THEY have never glanced at anyone, and THEY never need to.
THEY leave woven strands of fate for humans to walk, and together, THEY weave a great shadow... And this shadow silently envelops them.
There are always those who rise from the shadows.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: They mostly become a part of the shadow.
In your eyes, am I the same?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You still have a strand of color...
...But not much.
...That is enough.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Before they vanish completely...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I will reach {RUBY_B#Device IX}the Nihility's end{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What... is this place?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A gigantic black hole, and... sea...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Have... Have I succeeded?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: "...Welcome to this sad world, Kakavasha."
"Your good luck is the most precious wealth we — all Avgin have."
"If you come out alive after two days, it proves that you're the real deal."
"Wealth, status, power... the IPC will give you whatever you want, even what you don't want."
As for us, we will reunite in Kakava's next aurora.
It's a pity this is not the place you were expecting.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Nihility... is it?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Perhaps to you, I am just an Emanator who's hiding her identity, but...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Nihility IX}The sleeping and shapeless{RUBY_E#} never glance at anyone. THEY have no face, no form, and even less of a will to speak... The Nihility envelops everyone equally.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Only some who have gone under THEIR shadow can go farther, tainting themselves with more Nihility... That's all.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's all... My friend, you really leave me at a loss for words.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So... Is this my final destination, the land of the dead?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This is all but a fleeting dream, one of the thousands of manifestations of IX... Under the watchful eye of Nihility, we momentarily linger here, before moving on to our own paths.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It seems that my death has already been determined.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Even if you wish for it... I can't promise you anything.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Now that you've accomplished your goal, I think you can be a little more forthcoming.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Your performance at the theme park was wonderful and grandiose... A simple yet practical technique that fooled almost everyone.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: No one would have ever thought that you would have gone to such lengths, even staking your life, just to prove a fact that had seemingly been disproved long ago...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: "'Real death' does not exist in Penacony's Dreamscape."
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Why would I do this?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Because this is the only way you can uncover a secret that is even more unspeakable than the serial murders...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: To use this "dream death" to get there, to that promised land people constantly seek in this grand gathering...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Penacony — the Legacy of the Watchmaker, the true land of exile.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...How did you find out?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I never imagined that something I learned about unexpectedly would become the key to connecting everything.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's that person's identity, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I see you're in the know.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Let's just say I'd put money on the possibility.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: ...The murder isn't nearly enough to disrupt business as usual. Even if there were one or two murders on Penacony, most people wouldn't be personally affected — and that won't create any waves.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: This {RUBY_B#Memory Zone}dream{RUBY_E#} of theirs isn't a boundless sea, it's a lonely island. The Family used the Harmony to build a high wall and isolate them from the vast and treacherous ocean of the outside world.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: That barrier they built "keeps death out," but it also keeps the secrets that are lost in that watery abyss from floating to the surface. In a beautiful dream, free of suffering, who would want to go fishing for those secrets. No one. Unless...
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Unless someone goes to the other side of the barrier...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...And lives to tell the tale.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Someone already has.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I got the idea early on, chewing on that Masked Fool's little hint. If a mute isn't "someone who cannot make a sound," then it has to be "someone who cannot speak."
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Someone who survived the treacherous depths, but is unable to take the stage and speak the truth. I'm happy to know she's safe and sound, and still on Penacony.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: "Hint" ...is that not "proof"?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Proof is the one thing I don't have. The only thing that can prove these... conjectures... is for The Family to come clean. And with the way they buttered up these outsiders, it seems pretty clear they're intent on covering their tracks.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But you don't need proof to have a suspicion, and for me suspicion is enough. I didn't need to find the memory zone meme. I just needed for someone to kill me like it killed the silver-haired girl.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You don't sound very confident to me. Going out of your way to make citywide broadcasts in an attempt to involve more people... You are simply betting on the possibility of someone being able to "break down the barrier."
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You're very lucky that fate has decided to let us cross paths. I happen to be equipped with a very sharp blade — sharp enough to slice through the veil of dreams. I can also carve the Harmony's brand off of you...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: You possess great cunning. Deliberately setting us up to be on opposing sides, constantly repeating the words of the Emanator in front of others, leaving me no choice but to draw my blade against you.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: And that's how you win. Opportunity and strategy, both are essential.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: And in your plans, the IPC always wins. Even if you lose the bet... To The Family, the life of an ambassador is still invaluable.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's a huge gamble, isn't it? But, allow me to point out a mistake: The IPC's success is not guaranteed — I unfortunately have no contingencies for such an important matter.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Detonating a Stellaron... I can't do it. The aventurine stone is too broken to even safeguard my escape from the stage.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: If at the end of the day you did not unsheathe your blade... I would have lost the bet.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It is pointless to discuss "what-ifs." You have won. Your prize is an entry ticket into that deep sea.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: And after this, whether you can return from the abyss... is another gamble of yours.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Have you never wavered?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Wavered? Of course I have. But I can only bank on my own good fortune.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Because other than that, I have nothing.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: The light of the aventurine stone... has disappeared.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: This only represents one outcome...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: He kept his promise...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: "With hope for the morrow nestled in my heart, I descend into the slumber of tonight. Until the denouement of all coming morrows kisses me, I have then embraced the quiet death."
But this man is different. He lives and breathes in the present. In every sinking night, by every daring gamble, no vision of morrow ever graced his dreams.
His life knows not quietude. His fate yet demands him to win them all, to weather tempests, one after another... til mire enshrouds his very breath.
And now, in the unfathomable depths of dream, the once falling die... has at last landed on its earthly rest.
Quietly, peacefully, it at last landed.
...And got what he wanted.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: As planned, your cornerstone has been successfully sent to The Family's territory. Then—
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: —Let's fulfill our duty and start "harvesting."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: "I come to greet. I come to wine. I come to claim."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: "I grant poison for nectar. Sow in spring to reap in fall. Await wizened fruit to fill livened boughs."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: "All for the... Amber Lord."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Thereafter, in the cradle of slumberers, deep within the sweet dream of the Planet of Festivities —
Another stone begins to radiate light.
Where is this?
What happened?
And whose POV is this?
Yes. I'm [Trailblazer].
I think someone saved me...
Doesn't matter. I need to get out of here.
...You're awake.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I've been waiting on you for quite a while.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: You've met me before — I'm Sam — the Stellaron Hunter.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: A crevice between dreams. You've met me before — I'm Sam — a Stellaron Hunter.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I didn't do anything but wait for you to wake up. You've met me before, I'm Sam — a Stellaron Hunter.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I originally planned on showing up earlier to reveal some truths to you.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: But I encountered more roadblocks than expected. Eleven times, I've tried, but ended in failure. Before I knew it, this world and I became too intertwined and it became too difficult to escape the constraints of the "script."
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: ...Elio is right. In this Land of the Dreams, you and I will reap unforgettable gains.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: I also believe that, if it were their choice to make, they would make the same one.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I don't know people's hearts as well as he and Kafka do, nor do I have a specialty like Silver Wolf and Blade. Most of the things that I'm good at only apply to villains who need no mercy.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: So, there is only one method that I use.
rows.speaker: Sam

rows.text: Labyrinth-like corridors and halls, traps everywhere... The owner of this mansion must be a bit paranoid.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You're so funny, Mr. Security Officer. I hope that sense of humor of yours has helped you find the serial killer.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Just expressing a personal opinion. Why, did I hit a nerve?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Mr. Gallagher, my patience is wearing thin. Neglecting duties...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...will only make me more suspicious that you and the real serial killer are connected.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Scoundrel, punk, drunk, hooligan... I've heard this trash talk all too often. But I have never once thought that I'd be treated as an accomplice to a murderer!
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: I take back what I said: Your problem isn't paranoia. You're just crazy, you know? Lunatic.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: You — The Family — you broke my spine and pulled out my fangs, and now you want to accuse me of murder? Ridiculous, only idiots who've drunk too much SoulGlad will berate a stray dog on the streets.
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: What exactly is making you say all this nonsense? You should be more concerned about the outworld visitors who are making a scene in the theme park than me!
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Why do you think that I just let him go? And why do you think I emptied the theme park stage?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: I don't need you to remind me. The moment that ambassador walked out the doors of the mansion, I knew what he was trying to do. My servants see everything. His little magic tricks may have fooled me, but no matter, I'm happy to see how things have turned out.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Because my target from the beginning has always been you, Hound. The more noise he makes, the more opportunities I have to make you and your {RUBY_B#The Watchmaker}true master{RUBY_E#} pay in blood!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: If I were really the murderer, why would you need to be so secretive? Ha, I forgot, you also have {RUBY_B#Penacony's Dreammaster}a difficult master{RUBY_E#} to serve — telling you to ignore the murder case and focus solely on that Charmony Festival...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Isn't that right, my brother?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: ...Looks like your disguise has helped you successfully understand every facet of The Family.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Disguise? You must be blind to be accusing me of being a fake. Open your eyes and take a good look...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Indeed, every part of you is real. The brown hair, soft and curly like {RUBY_B#Dreamscape Producer}Benny's{RUBY_E#}; the orange eyes, which make me miss the gaze of {RUBY_B#Head of the Nightingale Family}Sir Whittaker{RUBY_E#}; that odd scar, the mark of {RUBY_B#Head Bloodhound Guard}Woolsey{RUBY_E#}...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: And the gray vest, tie, Hound Emblem, bottle, the bartending and your role as a security officer... These are all true traits...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...from all fifty-two loyal Family members.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: When they are gathered, countless tiny truths are woven together into a lie — you collected a small piece of each of them and claimed them for yourself. Then you invented this facade, a complete Gallagher...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Tell me I'm wrong, minion of the Enigmata.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Haha...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Hahahaha! You have guts. I'll give you that! Not bad. I severely underestimated you...
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: Admirable. But so what? Can this prove that I murdered your sister and that stowaway?
rows.speaker: Gallagher

rows.text: This proves that you and the Memory Zone Meme "Death" are linked — and that's enough.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Listen up. I don't care how you did it... I only care about one thing, the answer to a question...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...You devil! You wretched, despicable dog, why did you kill her!?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: ...Sure.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: What kind of help?
I've got something on right now.
I can't trust you.
You want to take advantage of The Family's trust in us?
The Nameless would never associate with the IPC.
A decision like this is way above my pay grade...
Come, this way — it's a short walk. Don't get lost.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Perhaps he's going for the Hotel?
Perhaps he's going for The Family?
Perhaps he's going for Acheron?
Perhaps he's going for the Astral Express?
No conclusions can be drawn just yet.
If Aventurine wants to bring down The Family, he'll have to create a big enough chance. After everything he's done so far — what is his goal...?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But why, though...?
Does Aventurine have other plans?
He's bluffing.
...She's a very gentle woman?
...She's a very mysterious woman?
...She's a very powerful woman?
Whatever happens, please don't place all your trust in Aventurine. We cannot afford to be manipulated by him.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Do you think The Family is behind all this?
We'll restore all the dreams back to normal.
This dream... is becoming more and more separated from reality.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, you two! That's a place of business. No entry!
rows.speaker: Hendrick

rows.text: Enough, get going. Don't keep Mr. Sunday waiting.
rows.speaker: Hendrick

rows.text: Wow, that's an enormous sandpit... I'd love to build a tall building for myself once I have enough savings.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Look, there's a noticeable gap in the model. I believe you're right.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Insert Gulliver's Arch into the slot.
Hey, I was talking to you.
You seriously are the worst soldier.
(Kick it again.)
One of the fragments flew upstairs. I'll need to use the pinball machine to flick myself up there, but it's tough.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Great. There's another pinball machine base here, and it's empty too.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Finally, a moment of peace.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: That's it... Pleasant moments of solitude are always fleeting.
rows.speaker: Dr. Ratio

rows.text: Thanks, Doc!
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: All done. Piece of cake.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Is it possible to access these records?
Feels like our every move is being watched...
Please continue to investigate the case. All I can do is sit tight in the real world. I look forward to hearing your progress.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I've got business with your Captain. Where is he?
I need you to pull some records for me. It's for official business.
W—We have nothing to report. Please leave.
rows.speaker: Composed Bloodhound Family Member

rows.text: Such tight security... I bet they're stumped by the case as well.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Gallagher... Gallagher... Where could he be?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This ain't it, chief. You've got the wrong {F#gal}{M#guy}.
That's right! It's-a-me, Clockie!
How about a clockwork trick?
Just what I've been waiting for!
But I can't abuse it for evildoings.
That's exactly what The Family has ordered us to investigate.
We are sorry too...
Regarding the Moment of Daybreak...
Regarding the Gilded Hour...
About the Blue Hour...
About the Moment of Dusk...
That's everything.
She's cool, indeed.
I think she is Serval.
Maybe someone else brought it here.
Maybe it's placed here for decoration.
Don't! It's no good for our drink if all shaken up.
I can only imagine how intense that scene must have been.
So, enemies drop gold coins even in a dream?
Just what I've been waiting for.
How come even you, Himeko...
Maybe it hasn't expired yet.
But I thought we could drink anything in dreams?
Give "Praise of High Morals"...
Give 50,000 credits...
Give a bag of trash...
There doesn't seem to be anything that can be put in...
Straws with concentric circles.
Hanu's sign.
Coin-shaped lemon slices.
Mikhail...
I heard this name in my dream...
"Death" eradicated her...
Maybe things will turn out different than what we think?
Is she a ghost!?
But what does this have to do with Mikhail?
So, the character "Hanu" is based on a real-life person?
So that Clockie cartoon is actually a documentary...
Can you convince them to let us in?
It's pretty impressive even from out here.
Who could that person be?
Is the Watchmaker an organization?
And that... The Family isn't all "united as one".
And that... "Death" is related to the Watchmaker.
And that... Clockie is based on the Watchmaker.
That pretty much sums it up.
While there aren't any people in this mansion... they've set up quite a few memetic guards to patrol this place.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: It's my turn to hide now! I bet you guys can't find meeee!
